note: Verdicts for upstream commits touching packages this fork deleted. Regenerate with `bun scripts/check-upstream-v2-delta.mjs --update`; see scripts/check-upstream-v2-delta.mjs for the gate itself. `tracked` = accepted debt recorded in packages/kimi-agent/ROADMAP.md §6; `not-applicable` = internal refactor with no observable engine behavior to port.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): upload images as file references for Kimi models (#3784)
entries.note: Upstream uploads images as file references for Kimi models and drops the oldest media (with a warning) when the accumulated request media exceed the size budget. The Rust engine still sends images inline as base64 data URLs (llm/openai.rs:145, llm/anthropic.rs:227) and has no media budget, so an oversized request fails instead of degrading.

entries.subject: perf(agent-core-v2): evict completed subagent scopes behind an LRU cache (#3778)
entries.note: Ported as a completed-scope LRU in the Rust subagent manager: `KIMI_CODE_SUBAGENT_SCOPE_CACHE_SIZE` (default 32, `0`/negative = never evict) and `KIMI_CODE_SUBAGENT_SCOPE_EVICT_TIMEOUT_MS` (default 15000) are resolved once per manager and an invalid value fails the first spawn (packages/kimi-agent/src/subagent/manager.rs:39,58); a terminal instance is retired (manager.rs:1781) and the overflow evicts the oldest completion's resident instance plus its in-memory conversation (manager.rs:1801,1854), leaving the persisted `subagent_resume` record intact so `resume` rebuilds the instance from it (manager.rs:1884). Persistent instances are excluded (their conversation is memory-only) and so is every manager without a session store, where the in-memory history is the only copy.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): align request and recovery stage names (#3766)
entries.note: Internal TS stage-name renames in the human LLM layer; no wire/protocol surface and no Rust counterpart.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): clarify human-layer names (#3727)
entries.note: Internal TS human-layer renames; no Rust counterpart.

entries.subject: fix(plugins): rename WebBridge display name to Kimi Browser Extension (#3803)
entries.note: The retired-package half is the capability entry displayName, which has no Rust counterpart (the plugin list comes from plugins/marketplace.json); the live-file half (marketplace.json, plugins-selector.ts, i18n) is not a retired-package delta and arrives with the normal upstream merge.

entries.subject: feat(oauth): switch the managed usage payload to the quota model (#3787)
entries.note: Rust /api/v1/oauth/usage is already a raw platform passthrough (server/oauth.rs:653-664,698), so only the client side moved: packages/oauth/src/managed-usage.ts now parses the usages map (limit_5h/limit_7d/limit_month_total/limit_month_code with used_ratio/reset_time) plus boosterWallet into the zod quota model and fetchManagedUsage returns {kind:'ok', quota} (managed-usage.ts:99-144,146,286); toolkit.ts:101-106,318-333 propagates it. The TUI rebuilds the panel from it: quotaUsageRows in apps/kimi-code/src/utils/usage/usage-format.ts:95 emits one row per window the backend served, usage-panel.ts:49-52,117-161 renders them presence-driven with the monthly kimi/code breakdown line, and info.ts:263 assembles the report. Fork divergence: the row labels and the breakdown line go through the fork's i18n (tui.messages.usagePanel.limit5h/limitWeekly/monthlyLimit/monthlyBreakdown) instead of upstream's hardcoded English. Tests: packages/oauth/test/managed-usage.test.ts, packages/oauth/test/toolkit.test.ts, apps/kimi-code/test/utils/usage/usage-format.test.ts, apps/kimi-code/test/tui/components/messages/{usage-panel,status-panel}.test.ts.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): fail fast on unsupported [secondary_model].default_effort (#3785)
entries.note: Ported to config/mod.rs:868 (validate_secondary_model_effort, called from extract_secondary_model_pool at :844) with model_supports_thinking (:1225) / model_supports_effort (:1244); the catalog model now carries adaptive_thinking (server/model_catalog.rs:54,79). Tests: config::tests::test_secondary_model_default_effort_validation.

entries.subject: perf(agent-core-v2): shard the session event bus by agent id (#3775)
entries.note: TS-internal event-bus sharding; Rust fans out one subscriber per session lane (server/hub.rs:227) with per-connection bounded queues.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): release disposed agent scopes from the DI dependency graph (#3776)
entries.note: No DI container or dependency graph in the Rust engine; subagent instance maps are deliberate resume state, not a disposed-scope leak.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): keep swarm cancellation from crashing the CLI (#3779)
entries.note: Rust swarm cancellation is a typed result (swarm/agent_run_batch.rs:454-456,836); the unhandled-rejection crash has no analogue.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): tower mode mistaking newly agents for previous name (#3752)
entries.note: The identity rules are ported: `resolve_caller_name` resolves an agent id to its latest roster entry (packages/kimi-agent/src/tools/tower/store.rs:338), `register_agent` retires same-agent-id entries before appending (:368), and `is_initialized` treats only a missing state file as uninitialized so an unreadable one cannot be re-initialized over (:68, used by `init`). No Rust counterpart for the died/revived bookkeeping (the Rust roster entry has no death fields), the ownership release/exit await (no owner session in `.tower/comms/state.json`), or the `enter()`/restore adoption split (TowerInit is the single activation path and already adopts the foreign roster).

entries.subject: fix(kap-server): verify indexed search results against session sources (#3631)
entries.note: Rust search reads the store directly (server/mod.rs:2644 -> session/sqlite_store.rs:1356) and session deletion cascades to messages (sqlite_store.rs:280,302-313), so stale-index hits cannot occur.

entries.subject: fix(kap-server): omit hidden thinking summaries from v1 session history fold (#3765)
entries.note: No hidden-think concept exists in the Rust engine (rpc/types.rs:487-491); llm/openai.rs never parses reasoning_details, so the history fold cannot emit hidden summaries.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): display reasoning_content over reasoning_details summary in chat completions (#3735)
entries.note: Rust already prefers reasoning_content (llm/openai.rs:380-390) and never reads reasoning_details; the hidden flag has no counterpart because no summary part is produced.

entries.subject: feat: declare dynamically_loaded_tools for official models and add per-server MCP deferred disclosure (#3667)
entries.note: All three parts absent: no dynamically_loaded_tools capability (server/provider_refresh.rs:83-141), no per-server deferred field (config/mod.rs:155-198), and select_tools is executable but never advertised (tools/tool_policy.rs:128-165).

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): fold the prompt queue into the agent loop service (#3747)
entries.note: The prompt-queue fold is internal (Rust queues/steers/aborts identically). The abort contract is ported: the `:abort` route now answers 40402 PROMPT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown or already-settled prompt (packages/kimi-agent/src/server/mod.rs:5497-5505), the Rust error-code table and packages/protocol drop 40903 / `prompt.already_completed`, and the kimi-web client's `allowCodes: [40903]` is gone. The absent prompt-image compression caption remains a pre-existing gap (ROADMAP §6.1 item 10b).

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): make the compaction attempt limit configurable (#3750)
entries.note: Ported to LoopControlConfig.compaction_max_attempts (config/mod.rs:317-321) + resolve_compaction_max_attempts (:936), threaded through RunTurnInput.compaction_max_attempts (turn_loop/types.rs:852) into CompactionConfig.max_attempts (compaction/mod.rs:55) and summarize_with_llm (:315-320). The fork takes upstream's default of 5 (DEFAULT_COMPACTION_MAX_ATTEMPTS, compaction/mod.rs:30) instead of the former hardcoded 10. The napi path has no parameter for it yet and passes None.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): graduate AI session titles from experimental (#3749)
entries.note: The auto_session_title flag is already absent from the fork's native registry, but the AI title path it gated is unimplemented: derive_session_title rejects source=digest (session/sqlite_store.rs:1777) and fetchChatTitle has no consumer.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): rebuild wire persistence and flip agents to session-spawned actors (#3737)
entries.note: Internal TS persistence/DI rebuild; the removed checkpoint-depth undo clamp never existed in Rust and the new wire-journal record family has no Rust counterpart (Rust persists to SQLite).

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): invalidate streamed attempt state when the llm requester retries below the turn (#3734)
entries.note: Rust turn_loop/retry.rs has no attempt-state invalidation; streamed deltas from a discarded attempt may survive into the retry.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): add KIMI_CODE_PERMISSION_MODE_REMINDER env to disable auto-mode reminders (#3728)
entries.note: The whole permission_mode reminder injection is absent from the fork (engine and app); the env flag is only its switch.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): compose the llm recovery chain outside the turn machine (#3724)
entries.note: Internal service composition inside the TS turn machine; Rust drives retries in turn_step/run_turn directly.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): suppress task notifications before loop quiescence on remove (#3720)
entries.note: Session-scoped notification queue: a task completion is only ever drained by the session that spawned it (packages/kimi-agent/src/storage/task_runner.rs:650, session/mod.rs:1394), so a removed session's notifications reach no session. Difference from upstream: the queue retains them instead of dropping them at removal — the engine has no session-teardown hook (session_dispose only drops the registry entry, napi_bindings.rs:2309).

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): rebuild session and search indexes on storage failures, journal session-index freshness (#3694)
entries.note: Rust session/sqlite_store.rs has no rebuild/reindex path on storage failure.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): keep late task settlement silent after agent teardown (#3717)
entries.note: Notification half ported (same session-scoped drain, storage/task_runner.rs:650). The event half is not: settle still fires event.task.completed / background.task.terminated unconditionally (storage/task_runner.rs:617-630), because the engine has no session-liveness source — SESSION_REGISTRY is bin-crate-only and keyed by the engine's own session-{n} (main.rs:1463), EventHub lanes are never evicted (server/hub.rs:126), and EngineSession has no closed flag.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): stop warning on unhandled store.changed events (#3715)
entries.note: Log-noise fix for the TS store event bus; Rust has no store.changed analogue.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): allow rm -rf targeting only /tmp or /temp paths (#3714)
entries.note: Ported to native/permission_engine/dangerous_command.rs (RM_SAFE_TEMP_ROOTS + is_safe_temp_rm_operand) with tests.

entries.subject: fix(goal): remove time budget cap and exclude offline time (#3657)
entries.note: MAX_REASONABLE_TIME_BUDGET_MS removed from goal/mod.rs; non-finite guard added; SetGoalBudget description and tests updated.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): plug llm credentials in through request config (#3682)
entries.note: Internal DI composition for credentials; Rust llm/http and config own credential resolution.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): drop the llm state machine, let turn invoke the request actor directly (#3710)
entries.note: Removal of a TS xstate machine; Rust has no equivalent state machine.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): replace ProtocolTrait with per-protocol typed traits composed in the requester pipeline (#3641)
entries.note: Internal trait shape; Rust llm/{openai,anthropic,google_genai,openai_responses}.rs are already per-protocol.

entries.subject: feat(kap-server): add flat entity message protocol (v3 WS + history API) (#3532)
entries.note: Contract-generation gap: Rust server exposes no v3 flat-entity WS/history surface, and apps/kimi-inspect still matches the pre-#3532 protocol.

entries.subject: fix(agent-core-v2): let steer interrupt background task waits (#3697)
entries.note: Rust steer handling is goal-steering text only; no evidence a steer interrupts a background-task wait.

entries.subject: feat(tower): reliability fixes (#3648)
entries.note: Upstream rewrote tower protocol store/send/spawn; per-fix comparison against Rust tools/tower/ not done.

entries.subject: fix(mcp): preserve original attachments omitted from model output (#3688)
entries.note: Rust preserves structuredContent/_meta but has no session-attachment original preservation.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): event-source the human agent state store (#3691)
entries.note: Applies to the TS human agent machine (human/agent/), which has no Rust counterpart; needs a decision, not necessarily a port.

entries.subject: feat(agent-core-v2): warn on [models] entries missing the model field (#3681)
entries.note: Ported to KimiConfig::malformed_model_entries (config/mod.rs:570), emitted via tracing::warn! from from_file (:555). The engine has no config-warning channel (event.config.warning and the v3 config.warning message have no Rust producer), so the closest existing mechanism — the engine log — carries it. Reads the raw TOML so the unquoted-dotted-alias hint survives (dotted_alias_suffix, :1280). Tests: config::tests::test_malformed_model_entries_warn.

entries.subject: feat(kap-server): stream raw xstate inspection events over /api/v1/debug/ws (#3687)
entries.note: Debug WS inspection stream; Rust server/debug.rs exposes REST only.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): remove AgentActivityView and project v1 agent phase at kap-server edge (#3678)
entries.note: Removal of a TS view model plus edge projection; Rust server projects its own phases.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): rewire the model catalog runtime onto the provider-catalog state machine (#3606)
entries.note: Upstream removed the per-model inspector and replaced it with ping + session creation. The fork still ships the inspector, and it is broken: apps/kimi-inspect/src/components/ModelCatalogView.tsx:368,522 call IModelCatalog.inspect, which the Rust debug surface does not serve (server/debug.rs serves only modelCatalog.listModels/listProviders). Porting upstream needs modelCatalog.ping, modelService.list and sessionManager.resume on that surface.

entries.subject: refactor(agent-core-v2): single producer for turn and step ids (#3662)
entries.note: Rust receives turn_id from the caller and owns step ids internally; no duplicate-producer risk.
